name: Molytropia: Dead Stars Still Shine Here
detailed_description:
Molytropia: Dead Stars Still Shine Here tells the story of events that took place on a winter evening in a small town. A young man meets an unusual girl on the train ride home. As they start talking, they decide to go stargazing together.

Molytropia: Like In That Movie, But Completely Different is fully available in the demo version. The story is told from the perspective of a young man who accidentally meets a paralyzed girl at a video rental store. Over time, their acquaintance grows into a friendship filled with lighthearted and amusing moments, as well as melancholic and bittersweet conversations.

Gameplay:

Similar to most visual novels. You read, click the mouse or press a key, then read again. And so on in a loop.

Features:

  • A warm, cozy atmosphere with a bittersweet undertone.

  • A tense, unsettling atmosphere colored by a sense of hopelessness.

  • Episode duration of approximately 40 minutes each.

  • A pleasant soundtrack and stylized artwork.
